description.value: Ramen Gojiro is Canada's first Jiro-style ramen shop, part of the Menya Kouji Group, specializing in voluminous gatsuri-style bowls with house-made noodles, rich pork-and-chicken broths, and extensive topping customization. The menu spans classic, spicy, tsukemen, vegetarian, and donburi options alongside house-made gyoza, making it a versatile and filling stop in downtown Vancouver. Pickup ordering and fresh noodle delivery are both available.
